change: Clarify 40 care-worker and care-provider situation contexts using only existing hypothesis meanings.

updates.title: I do not know whether new daytime drowsiness reflects poor sleep or another problem
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A change in daytime alertness leaves the worker unsure what to report or which assessment to request.

updates.title: I cannot access advice independently when a dispute arises with the household or agency
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker needs advice from someone outside the household or agency involved in the disagreement.

updates.title: A resident will not take a prescribed medicine and the agreed next step is unclear
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person declines a medicine while the worker has no agreed route for advice or follow-up.

updates.title: The available lifting aid does not fit the person's room or home
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The planned transfer depends on a lifting aid that cannot be positioned in the available space.

updates.title: I do not know what movement remains appropriate after a new injury or procedure
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: An injury or procedure changes the person’s movement needs without clear guidance for everyday assistance.

updates.title: A person's chosen clothes or grooming routine are difficult to support in the time available
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Supporting the person’s preferred appearance competes with the time assigned to other care tasks.

updates.title: Important information is buried in lengthy records when I need it quickly
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A care decision is needed before the worker can locate the relevant detail in the person’s record.

updates.title: Gradual changes are noticed by different workers but never brought together
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Each worker sees part of a developing change, but no shared account prompts follow-up.

updates.title: I cannot reconcile a person's religious wishes with the proposed care arrangement
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The proposed care arrangement conflicts with religious wishes that have not been worked through together.

updates.title: A complaint about care reaches me without enough information to respond
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker receives a concern without a clear account of what happened or what needs to change.

updates.title: An external service cannot access the current plan and asks me to relay it again
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker becomes the information relay when an external professional cannot see the current care plan.

updates.title: The wound-care instructions do not match the dressings available on my shift
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A planned dressing change cannot be followed with the supplies available at that time.

updates.title: I need a timely clinical decision but cannot tell whether my message was received
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker has sent a clinical question but cannot establish who will respond or when.

updates.title: A person fears falling and refuses to move despite wanting more independence
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person wants more independence but fear of falling prevents attempts to move.

updates.title: I must use a personal phone or unapproved channel to reach the team
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Reaching colleagues depends on the worker’s own phone or a channel the service has not approved.

updates.title: I am alone when a resident's behaviour puts either of us at immediate risk
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker faces an immediate safety concern without another person available to assist.

updates.title: I cannot tell which hours in the household are work and which are my own time
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Living in the care household leaves the boundary between duties and personal time unclear.

updates.title: A person returns from therapy but I cannot translate the recommendations into daily routines
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Therapy advice reaches the worker without a practical account of how to support it during ordinary care.

updates.title: I find a new skin injury but cannot establish what caused it or who will assess it
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A newly noticed skin injury has no clear explanation or agreed owner for assessment.

updates.title: The toileting plan changes between shifts and the person receives inconsistent help
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Different shifts follow different toileting arrangements, leaving the person unsure what help to expect.

updates.title: I do not know how the person wants cultural or religious practices respected
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker needs the person’s preferences before adapting care around cultural or religious practices.

updates.title: I must help a person transfer but the required equipment or second worker is unavailable
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A transfer is needed while the assistance specified in the care arrangement is unavailable.

updates.title: I cannot tell whether a person understood an explanation or simply agreed politely
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A polite response leaves the worker uncertain whether the person understood enough to make a choice.

updates.title: Several residents need help at once and I cannot give each enough attention
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Simultaneous requests force the worker to divide attention while each person still needs support.

updates.title: We cannot judge which local demand we can sustainably meet
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The provider must match local requests with the staffing, costs and capacity needed to sustain the service.

updates.title: I do not know when a split shift will actually leave me free
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The gap between parts of a shift has no reliable end point for planning time away from work.

updates.title: Equipment needed after discharge has not arrived when the resident returns
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The resident returns before equipment needed for the planned care arrangement is available.

updates.title: I discover a device fault only when it is needed for care
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A device fails at the point of use, leaving the worker without the planned means of providing care.

updates.title: A person arrives without information about how they communicate or prefer to receive help
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The first care interaction begins without knowing how the person expresses choices or accepts assistance.

updates.title: A move between services interrupts routines or relationships important to the person
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The receiving service needs to preserve valued routines and relationships during the change in care setting.

updates.title: My shift overruns but the extra time is not consistently recorded
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Work continues beyond the planned shift without a consistent record of the time actually worked.

updates.title: Experienced colleagues leave and take essential knowledge with them
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Knowledge of residents and local routines is lost when experienced colleagues leave without a usable handover.

updates.title: I notice unexplained injuries but do not know how to raise a concern without making an accusation
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker needs a route to report unexplained injuries while preserving the distinction between concern and accusation.

updates.title: We cannot tell whether a change after an incident has improved care
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A corrective action has been introduced, but the provider lacks a clear comparison of care before and after it.

updates.title: No one can establish whether shared equipment has been checked or cleaned
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: Shared equipment reaches the next user without a reliable account of its checks or cleaning.

updates.title: I do not have a private space where I can rest without interruptions
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The worker’s break takes place where care requests and other interruptions continue.

updates.title: Managers are expected to handle emotional fallout without preparation or backup
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A manager is responsible for supporting others through distress without preparation or someone to turn to.

updates.title: I cannot tell whether a resident's distress reflects pain, fear or something else
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person shows distress while the worker cannot establish what is troubling them or whom to involve.

updates.title: A change in ownership leaves residents and staff uncertain about service continuity
updates.before: A care-service operator or coordinator facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: A new owner takes over before residents and workers know which care arrangements will continue.

updates.title: Communication aids are not within reach or working during care
updates.before: A paid care worker facing this situation; direct research is pending.
updates.after: The person’s usual means of communication is missing or unusable when a care decision is needed.
